reason: The current stall-stability properties (a2 and a4) are not sufficient to capture the required behavior. Property a2 checks the stability of mdata when mvalid is asserted and mready is not, but it does not account for the case where mready is asserted in the next cycle. Property a4 checks the stability of mdata over two consecutive cycles, but it does not ensure that mdata remains stable if mready is asserted in the next cycle. A new property is needed to ensure that mdata remains stable when mvalid is asserted and mready is not, regardless of the value of mready in the next cycle.
